name: ai-alignment-revisability-audit
description: Review AI policy revision authority, rollback, oversight, and sealed operating evidence through the ICS hosted API.

interface.shortDescription: Audit AI revision authority, rollback, oversight, and evidence
interface.longDescription: A dedicated AI-governance plugin for policies, constitutions, model cards, and governance frameworks. It checks 28 written controls for authority, revision, version history, rollback, affected-party safeguards, monitoring, oversight, and technical evidence. Five industry profiles and sealed evidence-pack review are included. The plugin is free; hosted audits require a matching AI API key.
defaultPrompt: Use $ai-alignment-revisability-audit to review this AI policy for authority, revision, rollback, and evidence gaps.
